convert_data2vec_checkpoint: convert a fairseq data2vec checkpoint to a HuggingFace PyTorch model format
build_data2vec_masked_lm: build a Data2VecTextForMaskedLM model from a fairseq data2vec checkpoint with masked language head
build_data2vec_classification: build a Data2VecTextForSequenceClassification model from a fairseq checkpoint with MNLI classification head
verify_conversion_accuracy: verify the converted model produces outputs matching the original fairseq data2vec model
save_converted_model: save the converted PyTorch model to a specified output directory
